titulo.es: Un tribunal de EE.UU. ordena frenar las obras del salón de baile de Trump en la Casa Blanca
titulo.en: Iran plots to deal Trump a blow in midterms by keeping him entangled in war

sintesis.es: El Tribunal de Apelaciones de Estados Unidos para el Circuito de DC, que había permitido continuar las obras mientras estudiaba el caso, coincidió con un tribunal inferior en que una remodelación de la Casa Blanca de tal envergadura exigía el consentimiento expreso del Congreso.
sintesis.en: By dragging out talks, Tehran aims to damage the US president politically – but some fear a bruised and weakened Trump could lash back Tehran has set out a protracted negotiating timetable designed to keep Donald Trump embroiled in the Iran conflict until the midterm elections, in the hope of inflicting the same ruinous blow on his presidency as Jimmy Carter suffered over the 1979-81 US embassy hostage crisis. For many inside Iran, inflicting meaningful revenge on Trump is a legitimate and self-standing war aim, reflected in the mood of those attending the funeral of the supreme leader Ali Khamenei where demands for retribution were ubiquitous. titulo.es: Colombia: Temor por las tierras restituídas tras la victoria de De la Espriella
titulo.en: Colombia's Abelardo de la Espriella takes office, vows war on guerrillas

sintesis.es: La asociación de campesinos de "La Colombianita" denunció varios abusos por parte de las autoridades en sus terrenos. Esta denuncia se une a las otras muchas que ha recibido la Agencia Nacional de Tierras, la entidad encargada de gestionar los terrenos restituidos. Estos incidentes han generado dudas, tanto en los campesinos como para la agencia, sobre si el nuevo Gobierno del presidente de ultraderecha, Abelardo de la Espriella, defenderá sus derechos.
sintesis.en: Colombian President-elect Abelardo de la Espriella takes office August 8, vowing to launch a war on drug gangs and cosy up to the United States. The former lawyer won June's run-off election by less than a percentage point. He's a right-wing populist in the mould of El Salvador's Nayib Bukele and Argentina's Javier Milei, and is being sworn in in an unusual location.

titulo.en: 'DRC's largest Ebola outbreak on record: Active conflict and armed groups hamper the response'

sintesis.es: El brote epidémico continúa avanzando más rápido que la respuesta en muchas zonas de la República Democrática del Congo. Mientras la agencia de salud prevé publicar próximamente una evaluación sobre los tratamientos y las vacunas contra el ébola.
sintesis.en: Sharon Gaffney is pleased to welcome Heather Kerr, Country Director for Congo at the International Rescue Committee. The current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is unprecedented, not simply because of its scale, but because it spread undetected for months before it was correctly identified. According to Kerr, the response has been hindered by delayed diagnosis, the complexity of distinguishing this Bundibugyo strain from other common illnesses, and the immense operational challenges of working in an active conflict zone.

titulo.es: Meta es multada con US$567 millones en el mayor fallo por seguridad infantil contra la empresa
titulo.en: Meta fined $567 million in largest child safety ruling against the company

sintesis.es: Un tribunal estatal de Nuevo México, EE.UU., ordenó a Meta pagar 567 millones de dólares y aplicar restricciones a funciones de Facebook e Instagram para menores, tras determinar que la empresa creó una 'molestia pública' que puso en riesgo a usuarios jóvenes. La multa se suma a los 375 millones ya impuestos previamente en el mismo caso, totalizando 942 millones de dólares, y parte de los fondos financiará un programa de salud mental juvenil. Decenas de otros estados de EE.UU. mantienen demandas similares contra Meta por daños a la salud mental de menores.
sintesis.en: A US state court in New Mexico ordered Meta to pay $567 million and restrict certain Facebook and Instagram features for minors, ruling that the company created a 'public nuisance' endangering young users. This penalty adds to a previous $375 million fine in the same case, bringing the total to $942 million, with part of the funds earmarked for a youth mental health program. Dozens of other US states are pursuing similar lawsuits against Meta over harm to children's mental health.

titulo.es: New platform speeds bacterial gene mapping for better biotech design
titulo.en: New platform speeds bacterial gene mapping for better biotech design

sintesis.es: Scientists at the Department of Energy's Oak Ridge National Laboratory have created a platform that pinpoints genetic triggers that turn microbes into efficient factories for new chemicals and materials. The method enables rapid, precise reprogramming of bacteria as biotechnology tools, supporting domestic production of valuable products and recovery of critical minerals and materials to enhance the nation's supply chains and global competitiveness.
